subject: Update and pin github actions to full SHAs for supply chain security (#3185)
reason: The change pins GitHub Actions workflows to full SHAs (CI-only files under .github/workflows/) and fixes typos: comments, unit-test function/message spellings, TCL test comments, and semantically identical local variable renames (cpy->copy in sds.c/networking.c, aof_preable->aof_preamble in valkey-check-aof.c). No compiled behavior, command reply, replication, persistence, or tool output changes, so there is nothing for a scenario to exercise.
